headline: Intel Stock Surges 5%: Memory Upgrade and Google AI Deal Fuel Rally
summary: Intel (NASDAQ: INTC) stock gained over 5% premarket on Tuesday as traders leaned into a market rally fueled by a memory performance upgrade for Xeon 6, Google Cloud AI expansion, and strategic restructuring.

headline: Alphabet Q2 Preview: Stock on Sale? Analyst Says ‘Attractive Entry’ Ahead of Earnings
summary: A recent pullback in Alphabet stock could be a buying point ahead of earnings, an analyst says.

headline: Kimi Steals Spotlight, But Anthropic Cements Top Spot With Mathematical Discovery
summary: Kimi K3 crushed rivals and Alibaba claimed second place, but Anthropic's Fable 5 just disproved an 87-year-old math conjecture.

headline: Micron Leads Memory-Stock Rally, Nasdaq 100 Tops 29,000: Stock Market Today
summary: Semiconductors led a broad rebound Tuesday as Micron, Western Digital and Sandisk surged. Nasdaq 100 rallies past 29,000 points.
